go the extra mile.meaning: Nỗ lực hơn mức bình thường; làm nhiều hơn những gì được yêu cầu
go the extra mile.example: She always goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.

go the extra mile.meaning: Nỗ lực hết mình, làm nhiều hơn mức được yêu cầu
go the extra mile.example: The customer service team went the extra mile to resolve my issue quickly.

go the whole hog.meaning: Làm việc gì đó một cách triệt để, tới bến, không do dự
go the whole hog.example: If we’re going to renovate the kitchen, let’s go the whole hog and do it properly.

go through something with a fine-tooth c.term: Go through something with a fine-tooth comb
go through something with a fine-tooth c.meaning: Kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng, săm soi từng ly từng tí
go through something with a fine-tooth c.example: The auditor will go through the records with a fine-tooth comb to ensure there are no discrepancies.

go to hell in a handbasket.term: Go to hell in a handbasket
go to hell in a handbasket.meaning: Tụt dốc không phanh, rơi vào thảm họa
go to hell in a handbasket.example: With the economy collapsing, the whole country’s going to hell in a handbasket.

go to pieces.meaning: Suy sụp tinh thần, sụp đổ hoàn toàn
go to pieces.example: After hearing the tragic news, she completely went to pieces.

go to the dogs.meaning: Xuống cấp trầm trọng, đổ đốn
go to the dogs.example: After the new management took over, the company went to the dogs.

go to town.meaning: Làm việc gì đó với sự nhiệt tình và tập trung cao độ; tiêu xài thả ga
go to town.example: They really went to town on the decorations for the party.

go up in smoke.meaning: Tan thành mây khói, thất bại hoàn toàn
go up in smoke.example: The celebration plans went up in smoke due to the sudden storm.

go with the flow.meaning: Thuận theo tự nhiên, để mọi thứ diễn ra theo cách của nó
go with the flow.example: Instead of planning every detail, sometimes it’s best to just go with the flow.

go-to guy.meaning: Người đáng tin cậy, người chuyên giải quyết vấn đề (trong một nhóm/tổ chức)
go-to guy.example: When it comes to fixing computers, John is our go-to guy.

go without saying.meaning: Hiển nhiên, không cần bàn cãi
go without saying.example: It goes without saying that safety is our top priority.

golden age.example: The 1950s are often considered the golden age of American cinema.

golden opportunity.example: This job offer is a golden opportunity you shouldn’t miss.

good egg.meaning: Người tốt tính, đáng tin cậy
good egg.example: Tom is such a good egg; he’s always willing to help others.

good for you.meaning: Giỏi lắm, chúc mừng nhé (thường dùng để tán dương)
good for you.example: You finally finished your degree? Good for you!

good riddance.meaning: Mừng vì đã tống khứ được (ai/cái gì); đi rảnh nợ
good riddance.example: They moved out yesterday, and I say good riddance. They were terrible neighbors.

good things come to those who wait.term: Good things come to those who wait
good things come to those who wait.meaning: Trời không phụ lòng người kiên nhẫn; phần thưởng tốt đẹp dành cho người biết chờ đợi
good things come to those who wait.example: He finally got the promotion after years of hard work, proving that good things come to those who wait.

good to know.meaning: Rất đáng để biết, thông tin rất hữu ích
good to know.example: That is good to know for our trip.

goody-goody gumdrops.meaning: Tuyệt vời, ôi thích quá đi mất (thường dùng một cách trẻ con hoặc mỉa mai)
goody-goody gumdrops.example: The kids shouted, “Goody, goody gumdrops!” when they found out they were going to the amusement park.

go down like a lead balloon.term: Go down like a lead balloon
go down like a lead balloon.meaning: Thất bại thảm hại, không được ai hưởng ứng.
go down like a lead balloon.example: His joke about the boss went down like a lead balloon during the meeting.

go dutch.meaning: Tiền ai nấy trả, cưa đôi hóa đơn (khi đi ăn).
go dutch.example: Let's go Dutch on dinner tonight.

go under the knife.meaning: Lên bàn mổ, trải qua phẫu thuật.
go under the knife.example: He is scheduled to go under the knife tomorrow to repair a torn ligament in his knee.
